note: Every version of this site, oldest first. The era with the NEWEST date is the current one: it is what gets served at / and what the timeline marks as 'now'. Nothing is hand-flagged as live — shipping a redesign means adding an entry dated today and rebuilding. Historical eras are built once from their own commit and frozen into public/archive/<id>/ (see scripts/archive-era.mjs), each anchored at the LAST commit of its span so it is captured fully developed rather than on its first day.

eras.label: Create React App
eras.blurb: The first site — a Create React App scaffold with a resume PDF bolted on. Four commits over five weeks.
eras.build: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider npx react-scripts build

eras.label: gitfolio
eras.blurb: A generated portfolio from gitfolio: one static index.html listing every public repo. It stood for two and a half years — the 2022 'fresh start' commit rewrote the line endings and added a LaTeX resume, but left the rendered page byte-for-byte identical.

eras.label: Next.js, as launched
eras.blurb: The current generation on its launch day: Next.js App Router, dark, data read from public/resume.ts — 48 commits before it became what it was at the end.

eras.label: Next.js, as it ended
eras.blurb: The same generation two years on: data moved to data.json, every logo redrawn, a hidden research essay at /auto-complete.

eras.label: minimal
eras.blurb: One monospace column with build-embedded data, self-hosted accent faces, a clock-driven theme, and an Earthrise rendered in ASCII.
